title: あと一匹
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: LEFT ①: inside pink/leopard MELTY PUFF, Ageha hugs ONE cute new pink teddy bear and begs 「あと一匹だけ♡」 Hajime mildly concerned at nearby bears. RIGHT ②: gigantic wide street view: the ENTIRE cafe building has become a GIANT PINK TEDDY BEAR formed of thousands of white/pink plushies, bear head is the storefront, paws are doors, eyes are windows. Ageha and BLACK-CAP Hajime peek from the eye windows. Hajime says 「店がクマ。」 Delightfully ludicrous scale. Shop sign can read 「MELTY PUFF」. No ordinary generic plants.

qa.image_check: 配信用2枚は3:2許容内・1440×960以下・400KiB未満

qa.ratio: warnを記録し紙色補正を採用。強制通過なし。
known_deviations: 選別用の復刻候補。ゲームへの登録・採用画像の置換はしていない。
